messages.en: Look at this photo of the cave. It's a real natural wonder, isn't it?
Yeah, it's so beautiful! I want to see it for myself one day.

collocations.en: peace and stability in the country

messages.en: We all want to keep this neighbourhood peaceful, right?
That's right. If there's a problem, we can just talk it through calmly.
I want to repay your kindness, but I don't know what to do.
No need! Just help someone else out when you get the chance.
There's a fire at that shop at the end of the street. Have you heard?
Yeah, the firefighters have arrived too. Let's make way for them first.
